I am a Ph.D. student in Agricultural and Resource Economics at Colorado State University. My research focuses on environmental and natural resource economics, with an emphasis on flood risk, warning systems, disaster impacts, water policy, and applied econometrics.

I was born and raised in Kosovo. My first experience studying abroad was at the United World College of the Adriatic in Italy, where I completed the International Baccalaureate program, studied economics, and learned Italian. That experience shaped my interest in public policy, development, and environmental challenges.

I later moved to the United States to attend Colorado College, where I earned a B.A. in Economics. There, I became especially interested in environmental economics after taking a course that included a week-long field trip across Colorado’s Front Range and Western Slope. Meeting with water engineers, economists, farmers, and local decision-makers helped me see how economic analysis connects to resource management, infrastructure decisions, and community well-being.

My interest in water policy developed through research and professional experience in municipal water demand management, conservation, leakage reduction, and water supply planning. I have worked with Colorado WaterWise, the State of the Rockies Project, and the Young Water Professionals Group in Kosovo, which has helped me stay connected to water-sector work in my home country.

At Colorado State University, my current research studies the economic consequences of inland flooding and flood risk information in the United States. My master’s thesis, The Economic Consequences of Flood Alerts: Evidence from Employment Outcomes, examined how flood alerts and flood events affect county-level employment outcomes. I am also part of collaborative research on inland flooding, including work on flood risk management, economic behavior, and data resources.

Outside of my academic work, I remain involved in education and student support through the UWC Kosovo National Committee, where I support students from Kosovo applying to and attending UWC schools.
